: ${SRC:=.}
: ${OUT:=.}
: ${CC:=cc}
: ${CFLAGS:=-O -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -Wall}

#(cd .. && autoreconf -i && ./configure --enable-static && make V=1 all)

"$CC" $CFLAGS -I../src/ -I.. \
     "$SRC/magic_fuzzer.c" -o "$OUT/magic_fuzzer" \
     -lFuzzingEngine ../src/.libs/libmagic.a

cp ../magic/magic.mgc "$OUT/magic.mgc"
